Definition: to cut short, i.e. curtail (specifically the prepuce, i.e. to circumcise); by implication, to blunt; figuratively, to destroy
BiblicalUsage: 1) to circumcise, let oneself be circumcised, cut, be cut off; 1a) (Qal) to circumcise; 1b) (Niphal) to be circumcised, circumcise oneself; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to be circumcised; 1c1) of destruction (fig.); 1d) (Hithpolel) to be cut off; 1e) (Polel) cut down
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
